PluginData.Author: CometWorks
PluginData.Tooltip: Server rules of the Octahedron world
PluginData.Description: Server rules that only the Octahedron world uses: the economy stations' refill, refill containers, braking at the world's edge, starter ships from the stations' hologram tables, block limits for welded projections, a PCU cap per ship or station, shipyard welding in the stations' safe zones, ships ordered from the shipyards, a real account for the stations' faction with a daily wealth tax and an hourly dividend, station warehouse ledgers for players and factions, the station kiosks (with the Octahedron Kiosk client mod), the stations' contracts posted and paid by that faction, a partitioning-friendly spawn pattern for Modular Encounters Systems, and (on hold) the NPC encounters spawned from the plugin's own blueprints. Loaded from a checkout of the worlds repo as a local dev folder; it has no hub entry.
